E01.original_executable_definition: Event-time continuation: divide preceding same-day NQ volume into causal buckets each containing the prior 20-session median volume for 5 RTH minutes; after 3 completed buckets, require their signed net returns all align with `s`, then take `C15` in `s`.

E02.original_executable_definition: Directional-change overshoot: confirm a `1.5v sqrt(15)` reversal from the running 60-minute extreme; after confirmation, take the first same-direction overshoot of half that size.

E03.original_executable_definition: Volatility forecast surprise: EWMA(20) forecast of next 15-minute absolute return made at `t-15`; require realized absolute return/forecast ≥1.5 and `C15`.

E04.original_executable_definition: Online change point: two-sided CUSUM on standardized 1-minute returns with reference 0.5, threshold 4, reset at session open; first upward/downward alarm and `C15` same direction.

E05.original_executable_definition: Regime age: classify sign of EWMA(30) return each minute; require a new sign state between 5 and 20 minutes old and `C15` aligned.

E06.original_executable_definition: First-passage speed: after session open, time to first ±`2v sqrt(30)` displacement; require passage in ≤15 minutes and `C15` aligned.

E07.original_executable_definition: Occupation time: in last 30 minutes, fraction of closes above their 30-minute starting price ≥0.8 for long (≤0.2 for short), plus `C15`.

E08.original_executable_definition: Pullback duration/recovery: after `C15`, wait for counter-move ≥0.5 of impulse over ≥3 minutes, then recovery to prior impulse endpoint within 10 minutes; enter on recovery.

E09.original_executable_definition: Volume-time toxicity proxy: within the last 30 completed minutes, sum `sign(r)×volume` / sum volume has magnitude ≥0.6 and agrees with `C15`.

E11.original_executable_definition: Session handoff: direction of Asia (18:00–02:00), Europe (02:00–08:00), and US premarket (08:00–09:30) net returns agree; first RTH `C15` aligned.

E12.original_executable_definition: NQ/ES tail dependence: both standardized 15-minute returns exceed their own prior-60-session 90th percentile in the same sign, with NQ `C15`.

E13.original_executable_definition: NQ/ES relative value: rolling 20-session regression of synchronized 1-minute NQ returns on ES, fitted through prior session; residual 15-minute cumulative return exceeds 2 prior-session residual SDs, enter in residual direction.

E14.original_executable_definition: Relative regime transition: NQ and ES EWMA(30) signs disagreed for ≥10 minutes and become aligned at `t`; require NQ `C15` aligned.

E15.original_executable_definition: Trend age/exhaustion: count minutes since last CUSUM alarm E04; `C15` only when age 5–20, while age ≥60 is a preregistered negative-control stratum.

E16.original_executable_definition: Volatility term structure: ratio of EWMA 10-minute realized variance to EWMA 120-minute realized variance crosses upward through 1.5 at `t`; require `C15`.

E17.original_executable_definition: Multiscale volatility: realized variance of 1-minute returns divided by realized variance of nonoverlapping 5-minute returns over last 60 minutes ≥1.5; require `C15`.

E18.original_executable_definition: Liquidity-seasonality residual: NQ volume below its prior-60-session same-minute 20th percentile and range above its 80th percentile on two consecutive completed minutes; `C15` direction.

E19.original_executable_definition: Market-state transition probability: fit a 3-state sign/volatility Markov table on previous 60 sessions; take `C15` when estimated probability of a same-sign next state ≥0.65, with Laplace smoothing.

E20.original_executable_definition: Hazard continuation: among prior-60-session same-clock impulses like `C15`, estimate smoothed probability of reaching +0.5R before −0.5R within 30 minutes; require ≥0.60.

E21.original_executable_definition: Targeted TAKE/SKIP: fit regularized logistic continuation outcome model to *only* prior-session C15 events, using E03/E07/E10 states; walk forward monthly with a 1-session purge; take when predicted probability ≥0.60.

E22.original_executable_definition: Independent-state agreement: require `C15` plus E07 occupancy and E03 surprise, where both states were computed from distinct features; all three directions agree.

E23.original_executable_definition: Causal Kalman trend: constant-velocity state-space filter with process/observation noise fixed from prior 60 sessions; take `C15` only if filtered trend sign agrees and magnitude exceeds 2 posterior SDs.

E24.original_executable_definition: Distribution shift: Jensen-Shannon divergence between histogram of last 30 signed standardized returns and previous 20-session same-clock reference exceeds 0.15; require `C15`.

E25.original_executable_definition: Extreme-move clustering: at least 3 of last 20 absolute standardized 1-minute returns exceed previous-60-session 95th percentile; signed majority agrees with `C15`.

E26.original_executable_definition: Intraday excursion geometry: from RTH open, favorable excursion / (favorable + adverse excursion) ≥0.8 at `t`, with at least 30 minutes elapsed and `C15` aligned.

E27.original_executable_definition: Range-expansion topology: 15-minute range ≥1.5 × preceding 60-minute median 15-minute range, and ≥70% of that range was formed in the final 5 minutes; `C15` aligned.

E28.original_executable_definition: Return-volume elasticity: slope of log(abs return + tick floor) on log(volume +1) over previous 60 completed minutes exceeds its previous-60-session same-clock 80th percentile; require `C15`.

E29.original_executable_definition: NQ/ES cross-market elasticity: slope of standardized NQ returns on synchronized ES returns over last 60 minutes exceeds its prior-session 80th percentile; require `C15` with ES same-sign move.

E30.original_executable_definition: Continuation-failure predictor: at the **completed E08 recovery event**, a monthly logistic model uses the now-observed pullback duration, E16 term structure and E18 liquidity residual to predict stop-before-+0.5R from the recovery entry; take only if predicted failure probability ≤0.35.
